axioms.statement: The USD amount must be non-negative (throws if amount < 0).
For all amount >= 0, the result equals amount times 0.91.
The exchange rate applied must be strictly positive.
Applying a rate to an amount yields amount times rate.

units.name: applyRate
units.purpose: Multiply an amount by a positive exchange rate.

units.name: usdToEur
units.purpose: Convert a non-negative USD amount to EUR at rate 0.91.
